_comment: Copy to secret-map.<env>.json, one per environment, and commit it. Names and references only, never a value. secret:NAME reads the secret manager at _secrets.env/_secrets.path (or the environment under `infisical run`); env:VAR reads the environment; anything else is a literal. deploy/creds.<env>.json (ids, gitignored) is written by `./scripts/secret-map.sh sync` and `ids`. Skill: n8n-credential-mapping.
